text: CONTRADICTING: ApoE4 particles reduced the number of LysoTracker-positive acidic puncta in astrocytes compared with untreated and ApoE3-treated cells, while ApoE3 (and ApoE2) particles had no effect. This indicates fewer acidic late endosome/lysosome compartments with ApoE4, not more acidification.
description: Primary hippocampal astrocytes from P0-P1 wild-type Sprague-Dawley rats (expressing rat ApoE), DIV 6-9. Treated with 50 µg/ml recombinant human ApoE2, ApoE3 or ApoE4/POPC particles in HBSS (starvation) for 4 h, with 50 nM LysoTracker Red DND-99 for the last 30 min. Fixed and imaged by Airyscan; puncta per nucleus counted. n = 4 independent experiments (unit: independent cultures; 10 images per coverslip). Caveat: rat astrocytes, not human; exogenous ApoE particles rather than cell genotype; LysoTracker puncta count is a surrogate for acidification, not a pH measurement, and compartments are late endosome/lysosome rather than endosome specifically.

provenance.excerpt: We found that ApoE4 particles decreased the number of LysoTracker-positive puncta, while ApoE2 and ApoE3 particles had no effect (Figures 3A and 3B).
